DIXON corrected ~35% off the 18,471 52wk-high, bottomed ~9,600-10,400 in early-2026, and is RECOVERING: the monthly is +3.44% (green), the daily +0.97% with short MAs turned up + reclaimed, and the weekly long MA (~10,469) is RISING beneath = secular uptrend intact. Since the 260620 read (LTP 12,517) price pulled back -4.8% to 11,920, RE-TESTING the box-top / A-3.618 (11,829) confluence — i.e. the dip the prior read advised waiting for has largely arrived; price is AT support, not extended. The operator added a recent-leg ladder C (0=10,621 -> 1=12,882) and a third mid-ladder, sharpening the near-term targets and creating the decisive 10,621-10,626 cross-anchor floor. PREFERRED PLAY (watch, NOT held): (a) conservative buy = pullback/hold of the STRONG box 10,621-11,829, ideal adds at the 10,621-10,720 cross-anchor floor (cleanest R:R); (b) aggressive = a daily close back above the 12,360 daily long MA into 12,882 confirms continuation. CONFIDENCE: MODERATE — clean recovery reclaiming the box-top into a rising long MA, BUT into heavy 13k-18k overhead supply AND regime RED (favour the dip into 10,621-11,829, don't chase the reclaim; recovery-WATCH, not aggressive add).
